decisions.text: Used a 160x120 (4:3) viewBox for card illustration SVGs, 64x64 for nutrient/cycle icons, and 200x280 (5:7) for card-back.svg so all assets scale cleanly inside ~160x224px cards.

Designed Night cycle surface tokens as a cool moonlight slate wash (#DCE3EC / #CFD8E4) with a deep indigo header (#162032) rather than pitch black so dark ink text and sideways dead cards remain high-contrast on a classroom projector.
